title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of How to Determine the Place of Performance of Securities Repurchase Contracts

articles.content_en: 1. For securities repurchase transactions conducted within a trading venue, the location of the trading venue shall be the place of contract performance.

2. For securities repurchase transactions conducted outside the aforementioned trading venues, the location of the party making the initial payment (the reseller) shall be the place of contract performance.
July 4, 1996
